summary: Asked to draw herself, Nora now draws her mascot with her own reference picture instead of an empty room, and dates, times and places on a generated picture come from her clock instead of memory.
details: The image skill now states, at the point she decides whether she is in the picture, that the mascot is how she appears: not being a person does not mean having no form.
A new skill section has her write any date, weekday, time, timezone or place on a picture in full, copied from the turn's clock line, and resolve «this Saturday» against it first.
Her clock line now names the zone and its city: «…, Hong Kong time (HKT, Asia/Hong_Kong).» Before, it said «(HKT)» only, and no place was in her input.

The image tool's description now covers only the tool (667 to 275 tokens). Prompt-writing guidance moved to the skill, and how to report each result moved into the result itself. The size, aspect and quality options are now fixed choices in the tool schema.
limitations: The place is the city the deployment's timezone is named for, not anyone's location.
The three new eval cases (reference on «draw yourself», none on a picture without her, the date written out on a poster) have not been run yet.
The skill ships in the image: a rebuild is needed for it to reach production.
